title: Junior Technical Writer
description: Entry-level technical writer specializing in clear, active-voice product guides, API endpoint references, Keep a Changelog release notes, developer quickstarts, and Markdown/MDX authoring in Git workflows under senior editorial guidance.

skills.rationale: Must master plain English, active voice, Google/Microsoft style guides, and user persona empathy.
Core ability to write accurate REST API references, OAS/Swagger schemas, cURL commands, and getting started tutorials.
Writing step-by-step how-to articles, FAQ entries, and structured release notes.
Proficiency in Markdown/MDX, Git branching/PR reviews, and building docs locally with Docusaurus/MkDocs.
Conducting SME interviews with developers and reading PRDs/code diffs to discover feature requirements.
Authoring technical blog posts, meta tags, and conducting basic technical keyword research.

scoring.description: Weighted average of skill readiness scores multiplied by importance weights.

not_ready.description: Lacks fundamental clarity, struggles with style guide conventions, or cannot document basic REST APIs.

partially_ready.description: Writes acceptable prose but requires heavy supervision for OpenAPI schemas and complex Git workflows.

ready.description: Solid junior technical writer capable of authoring end-user guides, API references, and changelogs independently.

exceeds.description: Demonstrates advanced grasp of Docs-as-Code tooling, CI/CD linters, and complex SDK documentation.
